<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="9Ru-AbPbLfPZcZzeQB8Q"> <mxGraphModel dx="2146" dy="1098" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam componentStyle uml2
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam nodesep 60
skinparam ranksep 60

title Diagrama UML de Despliegue y Componentes — Peluditos Pet Chile (Entrega 2)

legend top right
 | Color | Estado del Componente |
 | <#DCFCE7> | Implementado en Entrega 2 |
 | <#DBEAFE> | Persistencia Relacional (MariaDB) |
 | <#FEF9C3> | Planificado para Entrega 3 |
endlegend

node \"«device»\nNodo Cliente (Navegador Web)\" as ClientNode {
 component \"«component»\nBandeja de Tareas Web\n(Proyecto-3-WebApp: HTML/JS/PHP)\" as WebApp #DCFCE7
 component \"«component»\nDashboard de Métricas\n[Planificado Entrega 3]\" as Dashboard #FEF9C3
}

node \"«executionEnvironment»\nEntorno Flowable OSS v7.2\" as FlowableNode {
 interface \"Flowable REST API\" as IFlowableREST
 component \"«component»\nMotor BPMN Flowable OSS 7.2\n(TO-BE Leads + TO-BE Fidelización)\" as FlowableEngine #DCFCE7
 IFlowableREST - [FlowableEngine]
}

node \"«executionEnvironment»\nEntorno Java 21 (Workers)\" as WorkerNode {
 component \"«component»\nExternal Worker Java\n(Proyecto-2-ExternalWorker)\nTópicos: registrar-lead,\nregistrar-resultado-lead,\nprocesar-fidelizacion\" as ExtWorker #DCFCE7
 component \"«component»\nWorker Notificaciones\n(WhatsApp/Correo)\n[Planificado Entrega 3]\" as NotifWorker #FEF9C3
}

node \"«executionEnvironment»\nServidor Jakarta EE / Grizzly (Puerto 8080)\" as BackendNode {
 interface \"API REST Negocio\" as IBusinessREST
 component \"«component»\nServicio Web Peluditos\n(Proyecto-1-WebServices)\nJakarta RESTful WS 4.0 (Jersey)\" as BusinessWS #DCFCE7
 IBusinessREST - [BusinessWS]
}

node \"«device»\nServidor MariaDB (Puerto 3306)\" as DBNode {
 database \"«database»\nflowable_db\n(Motor BPMN)\" as FlowableDB #DBEAFE
 database \"«database»\npeluditos_db\n(Negocio: leads,\nseguimientos, fidelizacion)\" as BusinessDB #DBEAFE
}

WebApp --> IFlowableREST : \"1. HTTP/JSON\n(Instancias y Tareas)\"
WebApp --> IBusinessREST : \"2. HTTP/JSON\n(Bandeja)\"
ExtWorker --> IFlowableREST : \"3. HTTP Polling\n(External Jobs)\"
ExtWorker --> IBusinessREST : \"4. HTTP/JSON\n(POST / PUT Negocio)\"
NotifWorker ..> IFlowableREST : \"Futuro Polling (E3)\"
FlowableEngine --> FlowableDB : \"5. JDBC (Estado BPMN)\"
BusinessWS --> BusinessDB : \"6. JDBC (CRUD Negocio)\"

@enduml",
 "config": null
